body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: A ranged physical Action targets the creature, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 Fortitude against that attack and move the creature 1 unit.

surges.html: Increase movement by 1 unit along a supported path.
If the attack still hits, reduce its Damage by 1.
